params.name: Text
params.description: The cue's caption text for this segment (source text of the AE text layer).

params.name: Font
params.description: Font family name; must match a family bundled in packages/fonts or installed system-wide (see README-AUTHORING.md).

params.name: Size
params.description: Font size as a percentage of the composition height (mirrors StyleDoc typography.sizePct).

params.name: Colour
params.description: Resting fill colour of the text (StyleDoc colors.text).

params.name: StrokeColour
params.description: Stroke/outline colour (StyleDoc stroke.color); ignored when StrokeWidth is 0.

params.name: StrokeWidth
params.description: Stroke width as a percentage of font size (StyleDoc stroke.widthPct); 0 disables the stroke.

params.name: ShadowOpacity
params.description: Drop shadow opacity 0-100 (StyleDoc shadow.opacity x100); 0 disables the shadow.

params.name: PositionY
params.description: Vertical anchor position as a percentage of composition height (StyleDoc layout.y x100).

params.name: HighlightColour
params.description: Colour applied to the active word/range while it is spoken (StyleDoc colors.activeText or accent).

params.name: HighlightStart
params.description: Start of the per-character highlight sweep (0-100 of the cue's character range), driven by the word timeline.

params.name: HighlightEnd
params.description: End of the per-character highlight sweep (0-100 of the cue's character range).

params.name: StyleId
params.description: The Aksharo style id baked into this instance; read back by the start-up self-test to confirm the param mapping.

params.name: BoxFill
params.description: Whole-cue background box fill colour (StyleDoc box.fill); has no visible effect while BoxOpacity is 0.

params.name: BoxOpacity
params.description: Whole-cue background box opacity 0-100 (StyleDoc box.opacity x100); 0 hides the box entirely.

params.name: MotionPreset
params.description: The D06 motion preset id (pop|slide-up|typewriter|underline|count-up|fade, CONTRACTS §2 TitlePayload.motionPreset) baked into this instance; a human AE author uses this to pick which animation preset the text layer plays (docs/MOGRT-PARAMS.md#title).
